edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent cutout vehicle preview for a website.
Input image: the supplied yadea.png is the edit target, not general inspiration.
Primary request: fix only the framing and cutout edge quality of this exact scooter.
Required edit: retain the scooter exactly, but reduce the entire subject proportionally so it occupies about 85 percent of the canvas height and width at most, leaving a clean transparent margin of 5–8 percent on all four sides. The complete upper-left rearview mirror must be visible, including the thin clipped upper rim; reconstruct only that small missing rim accurately. Center the complete object and its faint contact shadow.
Invariants: preserve this exact scooter design and physical components, camera angle, front pointing toward lower left, cream-white paint, sage-green trim, charcoal seat, "YADEA" badge, reflections, lighting, realistic rendered style, tires, wheels, lights, mirrors and side stand. Do not add, remove, redesign or replace any vehicle part.
Cutout cleanup: remove the white flecks, fringe, scattered pixels and jagged remnants around the outside silhouette, especially near the mirrors, handlebars and front body. Produce clean natural antialiased edges without a white outline or halo. Background and empty areas must be genuine alpha-zero transparency, not black, white or a checkerboard. Keep only a very subtle soft transparent contact shadow immediately under the tires.
Avoid: new parts, new accessories, a basket, a rider, scenery, floor plane, large shadow, labels or text outside the existing tiny YADEA badge.
edits.visualReview: Both mirrors now complete and visibly clear of the canvas edge. Overall design, badge, palette and view preserved. Transparent margins added, though narrower than requested on right/bottom. Some light edge speckling remains visible at full size; review at intended thumbnail scale before website use.

prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: a single transparent cutout vehicle image for the GoTogether carpool website, preview asset awaiting approval.
Primary request: an everyday YADEA electric two-wheel seated scooter, a friendly practical rounded city commuter. This is a brand-inspired concept, not an exact reproduction of a named model.
Subject: one complete cream-white electric step-through scooter with a dark charcoal long padded rider/passenger seat, two rearview mirrors, one rounded headlamp in the handlebar cowl, simple front shield with a tiny tasteful "YADEA" badge, low flat footboard, curved cream body panels, restrained deep sage-green trim, black rubber tires, realistic wheel hubs and a side stand. Compact, recognizable, cheerful, suitable for everyday Chinese city commuting.
Style/medium: high-quality realistic 3D product render with credible automotive materials and clean cutout edges, matching the realistic rendered cars already used in the website. No cartoon outlines and no illustration strokes.
Composition/framing: single scooter only, full object visible with both wheels, mirrors and rear seat inside the frame. Front-left three-quarter view seen slightly from above, front wheel toward lower left and tail toward upper right, equivalent to the camera angle of a car catalog front-three-quarter cutout. Keep enough side visible for the footboard and long seat to read at thumbnail size. Center the object with modest transparent breathing room, generous object scale.
Lighting/mood: soft studio key light, convincing molded bodywork reflections, gentle highlights, natural dark rubber and upholstery. Very subtle contact shadow directly beneath the tires, feathered into genuine transparent alpha.
Scene/backdrop: actual transparent background. No solid background, no floor plane, no parking-space outline, no scenery, no checkerboard rendered into pixels.
Constraints: two wheels only, no rider, no people, no helmet, no bags, no cargo box, no basket, no additional objects, no exhaust pipe, no fuel tank, no watermark, no headline or labels. Only a tiny YADEA badge is allowed as text. Preserve the broad practical scooter silhouette instead of a motorcycle or kick scooter.
referenceUse: Official brand product-category reference found through search; no downloaded photo input. Design is a general everyday scooter concept, not a claim to reproduce G5S or another exact model.
visualReview: Cream-white scooter with sage trim, charcoal long seat, tiny YADEA badge, two wheels, step-through footboard, mirrors, clear three-quarter view and transparent surroundings. Left mirror is very close to the top edge; allow more padding during eventual website preparation.
